entries.title: Persistence meets resistance
entries.literal_meaning: Tough iron meets a persistent smith.
entries.explanation: The same word changes force across the line: the iron resists, while the smith refuses to give up. The dictionary explicitly marks these two senses. The image suggests meeting a difficult task with sustained effort rather than expecting it to yield immediately. It need not turn persistence into an obligation to continue every losing effort.
entries.meaning_odia: ଲୁହା ସହଜରେ ବଙ୍କେ ନାହିଁ, କମାର ମଧ୍ୟ ସହଜରେ ହାର ମାନେ ନାହିଁ। ଏକା କୋଚଟ ଶବ୍ଦ ଲୁହାର ଦୃଢ଼ତା ଓ କାରିଗରର ନଛୋଡ଼ ଚେଷ୍ଟାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ୁଛି। କାମ କଠିନ ହେଲେ ଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଓ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟା ଦରକାର ବୋଲି ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରୁ ବୁଝିହୁଏ।

entries.title: Say what you want in time
entries.odia: ଚଇତା ! ତବତ ଖାଇବୁ କି ପଖାଳ ଖାଇବୁ ବେଳ ଥାଉଁ ଥାଉଁ କହିଥା
entries.literal_meaning: Chaita! Will you eat hot food or pakhala? Say so while there is still time.
entries.explanation: The pointed address and choice between hot food and pakhala turn a practical request into a memorable line: say what you want while another person still has time to arrange it. The dictionary marks Chaita as a non-respectful form of Chaitanya, so the tone can carry impatience or a dismissive edge. Applying it to other decisions is an editorial reading of the complete quoted example; its first occasion is unknown.
entries.meaning_odia: ତବତ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ନା ପଖାଳ—କଣ ଖାଇବ, ତାହା ବେଳ ଥାଉଁ କହିବାକୁ ଚଇତାକୁ କୁହାଯାଉଛି। ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା କରିବାକୁ ହେଲେ ଆମ ଇଚ୍ଛାଟି ଆଗରୁ ଜାଣିବା ଦରକାର। ସବୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସରିଗଲା ପରେ ମତ ବଦଳାଇବାଠାରୁ ସମୟରେ କହିଦେବା ଭଲ—ଏହି ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ ବିଚାରଟି ଏଠି ଖାଇବା କଥାରେ ଆସିଛି।
entries.english_summary: A meal cannot be arranged around an answer that arrives too late.
entries.odia_summary: ତବତ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ନା ପଖାଳ—କଣ ଖାଇବ, ତାହା ବେଳ ଥାଉଁ କହିବାକୁ ଚଇତାକୁ କୁହାଯାଉଛି।

entries.title: Care for the person doing the work
entries.literal_meaning: Take care of your body while carrying out your religious duty.
entries.explanation: The dictionary places this saying under caring for the body and health. Duty does not erase the needs of the person who performs it. In a wider everyday application, commitment and care for oneself can belong together; exhaustion is not the only measure of sincerity.
entries.meaning_odia: ଧର୍ମକାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ସହ ନିଜ ଦିହକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଜଗିବାକୁ କଥାଟି କହୁଛି। ନିଷ୍ଠା ଥିଲେ ବି ନିଜ ଶକ୍ତି ଓ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତାକୁ ଭୁଲିଯିବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ। ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ କାମରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ନେବା ଓ ନିଜକୁ ସମ୍ଭାଳିବା ପରସ୍ପରର ବିରୋଧୀ ନୁହେଁ।

entries.title: Embarrassed on someone else’s behalf
entries.odia: ନାଚିଲା ଲୋକକୁ ଲାଜ ନାହିଁ ଦେଖିଲା ଲୋକକୁ ଲାଜ
entries.literal_meaning: The person dancing feels no embarrassment; the person watching does.
entries.explanation: The dictionary explains a mismatch: someone behaves without embarrassment while witnesses feel ashamed on that person’s behalf. The saying can name that uncomfortable distance between an action and how it appears to others. Its image need not be used to condemn dancing or to police someone’s harmless enjoyment.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯେଉଁ ଲୋକ କାମଟି କରୁଛି, ତାକୁ ଲାଜ ଲାଗୁନାହିଁ; ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ତା ପାଇଁ ଅସହଜ ହେଉଛି। ନିଜ ଆଚରଣ ଅନ୍ୟଙ୍କୁ କିପରି ଲାଗୁଛି, ସେଥିପ୍ରତି ଅସଚେତନ ରହିଲେ ଏଭଳି ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏଠି ନାଚର ଚିତ୍ର ଅଛି ବୋଲି ନାଚିବାକୁ ଲଜ୍ଜାର କାମ ଭାବିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।

entries.title: A seed bigger than its fruit
entries.odia: ବାର ହାତ କାକୁଡ଼ିର ତେର ହାତ ମଞ୍ଜି
entries.literal_meaning: A cucumber twelve cubits long contains a seed thirteen cubits long.
entries.explanation: The part has become larger than the whole that supposedly contains it. The dictionary explicitly calls this an impossible claim. The absurd measurements make a quick test for an exaggerated story: do its own details fit together? The point is inconsistency, not an accurate description of cucumber growth.
entries.meaning_odia: କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାର ହାତ, ହେଲେ ତା ଭିତର ମଞ୍ଜି ତେର ହାତ—ହିସାବଟି ନିଜେ ନିଜକୁ ଖଣ୍ଡନ କରୁଛି। ଅସମ୍ଭବ କଥାକୁ ବଡ଼ କରି କହିବାର ମଜା ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଅଛି। କାହାର କଥାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅଂଶ ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ସହ ମେଳ ନଖାଇଲେ, ତାହାକୁ ଏହିପରି ହସି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରାଯାଇପାରେ।
entries.english_summary: The part has become larger than the whole that supposedly contains it.

entries.title: A boat needs a river
entries.literal_meaning: What can a boat do when the river dries up?
entries.explanation: A useful boat cannot replace the water it needs. The image invites a distinction between ability and the conditions that make ability useful. When an essential resource disappears, blaming the tool or the person alone may miss the real obstacle. This wider application is an editorial interpretation of the quoted saying.
entries.meaning_odia: ନାଆ ଭଲ ଥିଲେ ବି ଶୁଖିଲା ନଈରେ ଚାଲିପାରିବ ନାହିଁ। କାମ କରିବାର କ୍ଷମତା ସହ ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଦରକାରୀ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ମଧ୍ୟ ରହିବା ଦରକାର। ମୂଳ ସାଧନଟି ନଥିଲେ କେବଳ ଲୋକ ବା ଯନ୍ତ୍ରକୁ ଦୋଷ ଦେଇ ସମସ୍ୟା ବୁଝିହେବ ନାହିଁ—ନଈ ଓ ନାଆର ଚିତ୍ରରୁ ଏହି ବିଚାରଟି ଆସେ।

entries.title: When spending outgrows income
entries.literal_meaning: Like the temple’s front hall exceeding the temple itself.
entries.explanation: The dictionary explicitly applies this architectural comparison to expenditure exceeding income. What should be a supporting part has grown beyond the thing that supports it. The image asks us to notice proportion in a plan, especially when its surrounding costs threaten to consume more than the available means.
entries.meaning_odia: ଦେଉଳଠାରୁ ତାର ସାମନା ମଣ୍ଡପ ବଡ଼ ହୋଇଯିବାର ତୁଳନା ଏଠି ଆସିଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ଆୟଠାରୁ ବ୍ୟୟ ବଢ଼ିଯିବା ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିଛି। ମୂଳ କାମ ପାଇଁ ଯେତିକି ସମ୍ବଳ ଅଛି, ତାଠାରୁ ଆୟୋଜନର ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ବଢ଼ିଗଲେ ଅନୁପାତଟି ବିଗିଡ଼ିଯାଏ।

entries.title: A whole village stirred by one household
entries.odia:
ଅପାଇ ପାଇଚି ପିଲା,
ନା ଗାଁ ଯାକ କିଲିବିଲା...!!!
entries.literal_meaning: Apai has got a child; the whole village is in a commotion.
entries.explanation: A private event becomes everybody’s noisy business. The source introduces this saying as something used when someone makes too much of a display. Its joke lies in the size of the response: one household’s news seems to shake an entire village.
entries.meaning_odia: ଜଣଙ୍କ ଘରେ ପିଲା ହେବାର ଖବର, ଅଥଚ ଗାଁ ସାରା କିଲିବିଲି। ନିଜ କଥାକୁ ନେଇ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଦେଖେଇ ହେଲେ ଏହି ଉକ୍ତିରେ ପରିହାସ କରାଯାଏ। ଛୋଟ ପରିସରର ଘଟଣାକୁ ବଡ଼ ହୋହଲ୍ଲା କରିଦେବାର ତୁଳନାଟି ଏହାକୁ ମନେ ରଖାଏ।
entries.usage_example: A small household purchase is announced repeatedly to every neighbour, with more ceremony than the occasion seems to need. (Original imagined occasion.)
entries.cultural_context: The source explicitly supplies a display/show-off context. Apai is retained as an unidentified source designation; no historical person, kinship role or gender is inferred. The criticism is of disproportionate display, not of celebrating a child.
entries.odia_summary: ନିଜ ଘରର ଖବରକୁ ଗାଁ ସାରା ହୋହଲ୍ଲା କରିଦେବାକୁ ଏହି ଉକ୍ତି ପରିହାସ କରେ।
entries.english_summary: One household’s news turns into a village-wide commotion: a joke about excessive display.

entries.title: Boasting beside the kitchen stove
entries.odia:
ଚୂଲିମୂଳେ ନହୁଣିଆ ପାରୁଥିବ ବିଲେଇ...
ପୁଅ ଦେଖଉଚି ନୁଖୁରା ବଡ଼େଇ...!!
entries.literal_meaning: The cat may be doing nahunia exercises beside the stove; the boy displays empty boasting.
entries.explanation: The source introduces this line for unnecessary swagger. A cat’s ordinary-looking movement by the stove is set beside a boy making much of himself. The disproportion makes the boast look small: loud self-display is not itself an achievement.
entries.meaning_odia: ଚୁଲି ପାଖରେ ବିଲେଇ ନହୁଣିଆ ପାରୁଛି, ଆଉ ପୁଅ ବଡ଼େଇ ଦେଖାଉଛି—ଏହି ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଯଥା ଆସ୍ଫାଳନକୁ ଛୋଟ କରିଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଉତ୍ସରେ ବି ଅଯଥା ଆସ୍ଫାଳନ କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ପାଇଁ ଉକ୍ତିଟି ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। କଥାର ଜୋର ଦେଖାଇବା ଓ ସତରେ କିଛି କରିବା ଏକ କଥା ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Someone claims to be an expert after one easy practice task, and a friend gently punctures the swagger. (Original imagined occasion.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary lists nahunia as a kind of bodily exercise, which supports retaining an exercise image; no precise pose or movement sequence is established. The source’s own usage condition supports the swagger reading. The literal rendering of ନୁଖୁରା as empty remains contextual rather than separately dictionary-certified.
entries.odia_summary: ବିଲେଇର ଚୁଲିପାଖ ଚଳନ ସହ ପୁଅର ବଡ଼େଇକୁ ମିଳାଇ ଅଯଥା ଆସ୍ଫାଳନକୁ ପରିହାସ କରାଯାଇଛି।
entries.english_summary: A kitchen-side cat gives a comic counter-image to someone’s exaggerated swagger.
